title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Buccaneers D/ST allows 23 points Sunday
items.desc: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 23 points on  267 total yards with two sacks.
items.impact: It was a prime matchup for Tampa Bay against Deshaun Watson and the Browns offense and they failed to come through. They draw the Vikings next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase McLaughlin makes four field goals Sunday
items.desc: Chase McLaughlin connected on 4-of-4 field goal attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: McLaughlin made field goals from 59, 45, 31 and 31 yards out. He'll remain a reliable option for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cade Otton catches five passes Sunday
items.desc: Cade Otton caught 5-of-6 targets for 38 yards in the Buccaneers 23-19 loss against the Browns.
items.impact: Otton was a safety blanket all afternoon for Baker Mayfield. He remains a TE2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ted Hurst III sees seven targets Sunday
items.desc: Ted Hurst III caught 2-of-7 targets for 27 yards in the Buccaneers 23-19 loss against the Browns.
items.impact: Hurst led Tampa Bay in targets, but they did not result in much of anything production wise. He is on the upside WR4 radar right now for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Godwin Jr. totals 46 yards Sunday
items.desc: Chris Godwin Jr. caught 3-of-3 targets for 46 yards in the Buccaneers 23-19 loss against the Browns.
items.impact: Godwin was mostly quiet for the second straight week as Baker Mayfield has continued to struggle. He'll be on the WR3/WR4 radar next week against the Vikings.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emeka Egbuka has touchdown salvage performance Sunday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka caught 3-of-5 targets for 16 yards and a touchdown in the Buccaneers 23-19 loss against the Browns.
items.impact: It would have been a disastrous afternoon for Egbuka if it weren't for a touchdown he hauled in. He'll remain a WR2 play next week against the Vikings.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Gainwell remains in limited role Sunday
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell ran for 10 yards on two carries in the Buccaneers 23-19 loss against the Browns. He also caught 3-of-4 targets for five yards receiving.
items.impact: Bucky Irving was the clear lead back for the second straight week. Gainwell remains a pure stash for fantasy managers in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bucky Irving totals 21 touches Sunday
items.desc: Bucky Irving ran for 89 yards on 17 carries in the Buccaneers 23-19 loss against the Browns. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for one yard receiving.
items.impact: Irving had one long run of 38 yards, but was otherwise inefficient on the day. He did remain the clear lead back ahead of Kenneth Gainwell. He draws a tough matchup against the Vikings next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield continues to struggle Sunday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield completed 21-of-34 passes for 182 yards with one touchdown and one interception in the Buccaneers 23-19 loss against the Browns.
items.impact: Mayfield got off to another rough start. He did not fumble in this game, but instead threw an interception and struggled again overall. He draws a tough matchup against the Vikings next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Browns D/ST keeps Buccaneers offense in check
items.desc: The Browns D/ST allowed 19 points on 313 total yards with one interception and three sacks on Sunday against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: The Browns defense was able to help lead the team to an upset win over Tampa Bay. They'll face Bryce Young and the Panthers next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andre Szmyt connects on five kicks Sunday
items.desc: Andre Szmyt connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Szmyt made field goals from 50 yards out plus two more from 34 yards out. He is less reliable week-to-week on the Browns offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Harold Fannin Jr. catches five passes Sunday
items.desc: Harold Fannin Jr. caught 5-of-6 targets for 54 yards in the Browns 23-19 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Fannin was able to bounce back after being held without a catch last week. He remains a low-end TE1 heading into next week against the Panthers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jerry Jeudy held without catch Sunday
items.desc: Jerry Jeudy did not catch his lone target in the Browns 23-19 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Denzel Boston has emerged as the WR1 on the Browns offense. Jeudy remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: KC Concepcion Jr. catches six passes Sunday
items.desc: KC Concepcion Jr. caught 6-of-6 targets for 28 yards in the Browns 23-19 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
items.impact: Concepcion caught all six targets he saw, but they only resulted in 28 yards. Denzel Boston has appeared to emerge as the WR1 on the Browns offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Denzel Boston snags another touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Denzel Boston caught 5-of-7 targets for 95 yards and a touchdown in the Browns 23-19 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: Boston connected with Deshaun Watson on a touchdown for the second straight week. He is seemingly emerging as the clear WR1 on the Browns offense. He'll hold some upside WR3 appeal next week for fantasy managers against the Panthers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Raheim Sanders sees two carries Sunday
items.desc: Raheim Sanders ran for four yards on two carries in the Browns 23-19 win over the Buccaneers. He also caught his lone target for seven yards receiving.
items.impact: Sanders remains off the fantasy radar in his current role behind Quinshon Judkins.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quinshon Judkins sees 17 touches Sunday
items.desc: Quinshon Judkins ran for 21 yards on 12 carries in the Browns 23-19 win over the Buccaneers. He also caught 5-of-5 targets for 27 yards receiving.
items.impact: Judkins was shut down on the ground, but somewhat salvaged his day in the passing game for fantasy managers in PPR leagues. His upside remains limited given his situation.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deshaun Watson bounces back Sunday
items.desc: Deshaun Watson completed 24-of-30 passes for 238 yards and two touchdowns in the Browns 23-19 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
items.impact: Watson saw his accuracy improve significantly on Sunday compared to last week. He connected with rookie WR Denzel Boston on a touchdown for the second straight week. He'll figure to remain the starter next week against the Panthers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Texans D/ST totals five sacks Sunday
items.desc: The Texans D/ST allowed 20 points on 267 total yards with five sacks on Sunday against the Bengals.
items.impact: Houston was able to get pressure on Joe Burrow all afternoon, but Ja'Marr Chase burned them for a pair of touchdowns. They will face Daniel Jones and the Colts next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ka'imi Fairbairn makes two field goals Sunday
items.desc: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on 2-of-3 field goal attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Fairbairn connected on field goals from 37 and 45 yards out. He missed from 58 yards out in the third quarter.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dalton Schultz explodes for 12 catches Sunday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz caught 12-of-14 targets for 140 yards in the Texans 20-6 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
items.impact: Schultz was the Texans pass catcher who stepped up big time in the absence of Nico Collins. He'll remain a strong TE1 play if Collins remains sidelined next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylin Noel catches one pass Sunday
items.desc: Jaylin Noel caught 1-of-5 targets for 31 yards in the Texans 20-6 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
items.impact: Noel was one of six players to see at least five targets for Houston on Sunday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role with the ball being spread around.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Hutchinson sees nine targets Sunday
items.desc: Xavier Hutchinson caught 3-of-9 targets for 37 yards in the Texans 20-6 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
items.impact: With Nico Collins sidelined, Hutchinson led Houston in targets. It did not lead to much production. He could be in the streaming conversation in deeper leagues next week if Collins remains sidelined.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kayshon Boutte catches three passes Sunday
items.desc: Kayshon Boutte caught 3-of-5 targets for 37 yards in the Texans 20-6 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
items.impact: Boutte continues to learn the playback in his second game with the Texans. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role as an upside WR4/WR5.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Woody Marks active in receiving game Sunday
items.desc: Woody Marks ran for eight yards on eight carries in the Texans 20-6 loss against the Bengals on Sunday. He also caught 5-of-6 targets for 27 yards receiving.
items.impact: Marks and David Montgomery were both completely shut down on the ground. Marks salvaged his afternoon with five receptions. He will be on the flex radar in deeper leagues next week against the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Montgomery sees just six carries Sunday
items.desc: David Montgomery ran for 10 yards on six carries in the Texans 20-6 loss against the Bengals on Sunday. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for 14 yards receiving.
items.impact: After a huge Week 1 performance, it was a game to forget for Montgomery and the entire Texans run game. He'll look to bounce back next week against the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: C.J. Stroud attempts 55 passes Sunday
items.desc: C.J. Stroud completed 30-of-55 passes for 353 yards in the Texans 20-6 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
items.impact: Stroud did not throw a touchdown or interception in the loss. He had a productive day through the air, but the Texans run game did not help him. He'll face the Colts next week where Houston will hope to get Nico Collins back.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bengals D/ST posts another strong performance Sunday
items.desc: The Bengals D/ST allowed six points on 374 total yards with four sacks on Sunday against the Texans.
items.impact: It is the second straight strong performance to start the season for the Bengals defense. They will be on the streaming radar next week against Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Evan McPherson connects on four kicks Sunday
items.desc: Evan McPherson made both field goal and extra point attempts on Sunday against the Texans.
items.impact: McPherson connected on field goals from 51 and 57 yards out. He remains fairly safe for fantasy managers week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Gesicki not targeted Sunday
items.desc: Mike Gesicki did not see a target in the Bengals 20-6 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
items.impact: Gesicki was coming off a big Week 1 performance. He remains a touchdown dependent TE2 week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrei Iosivas catches one pass Sunday
items.desc: Andrei Iosivas caught his lone target for seven yards in the Bengals 20-6 win over the Texans on Sunday.
items.impact: Iosivas remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tee Higgins racks up 95 yards Sunday
items.desc: Tee Higgins caught 5-of-10 targets for 95 yards in the Bengals 20-6 win over the Texans on Sunday.
items.impact: Higgins recorded several big catch and runs in the first half against a strong Texans defense. He remains an upside WR2 heading into next week against the Steelers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase hauls in two touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase caught 7-of-9 targets for 75 yards and two touchdowns in the Bengals 20-6 win over the Texans on Sunday.
items.impact: Chase recorded both of the touchdowns scored by Cincinnati on Sunday, including an incredible catch where he just barely got both feet in. He remains a locked and loaded WR1 heading into next week against the Steelers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Samaje Perine sees three touches Sunday
items.desc: Samaje Perine ran for six yards on two carries in the Bengals 20-6 win over the Texans on Sunday. He also caught his lone target for 16 yards receiving.
items.impact: Perine remains a pure stash behind Chase Brown.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase Brown sees 20 carries Sunday
items.desc: Chase Brown ran for 80 yards on 20 carries in the Bengals 20-6 win over the Texans on Sunday. He also caught 3-of-5 targets for two yards receiving.
items.impact: Brown did not find the end zone. He ran well, but it was still a fairly quiet day for him overall for fantasy managers. He'll remain an RB1 against the Steelers next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Burrow tosses two touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: Joe Burrow completed 20-of-31 passes for 207 yards and two touchdowns in the Bengals 20-6 win over the Texans on Sunday.
items.impact: Burrow took five sacks, but he was able to avoid any turnovers with a pair of touchdown passes to Ja'Marr Chase. He'll look to keep it going against the Steelers in a Divisional matchup next week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Tyler Allgeier gets seven touches in loss
items.desc: Tyler Allgeier ran five times for 10 yards and caught both of his targets for 9 yards in the Cardinals' 31-7 loss to the Seahawks on Sunday.
items.impact: Allgeier played second fiddle to Jeremiyah Love on Sunday, which is to be expected. He wasn't particularly efficient on his limited work, but no one in the offense really got going anyway. It was tough sledding for the veteran, but hopefully things will get a little easier against San Fransisco next Sunday.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. sees one target in loss
items.desc: Marvin Harrison Jr. failed to catch his only target in the Cardinals' 31-7 loss to Seattle on Sunday.
items.impact: This is a big development for Harrison. He only caught one pass in the season opener, and now that has escalated to just a single target in this game. It's unclear if the team has given up on him, or if it's more of a lack of effort on his part, QB Jacoby Brissett looking elsewhere when targeting receivers, or some combination of all three. Either way, the team needs to figure out a way to use their 2024 first-round investment. That, or trade him away to a new team and acquire assets while he gets a fresh start.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Michael Wilson sees seven targets in loss
items.desc: Michael Wilson caught two of seven targets for 18 yards in the Cardinals' 31-7 loss to the Seahawks on Sunday.
items.impact: Wilson failed to connect with QB Jacoby Brissett in this game, and fantasy managers will be wishing for more after such a bad showing. He wil look to bounce back against the Niners next Sunday.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Trey McBride snags touchdown in loss to Seattle
items.desc: Trey McBride caught eight of 10 targets for 41 yards and a score in the Cardinals' 31-7 loss to the Seahawks on Sunday.
items.impact: McBride was the only thing working for the offense on Sunday, and even that only lasted but for so long. Seattle completely shut down the Cardinals in the second half, and McBride with them. But, it's doubtful any fantasy manager will complain about eight catches for 40+ yards and a score from their tight end.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jeremiyah Love struggles in loss to Seattle
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love ran nine times for 29 yards and caught three passes for 16 yards in the Cardinals' 31-7 loss to Seattle.
items.impact: Like the rest of the Cardinals' offense, Love struggled to move the ball against the Seahawks' stout defense. He will face yet another tough matchup next week, as Arizona takes on San Francisco.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jacoby Brissett struggles in loss to Seattle
items.desc: Jacoby Brissett completed 17 of 28 passes for 95 yards with a touchdown and an interception in the Cardinals' 31-7 loss to the Seahawks.
items.impact: Brissett did not look good in this game, failing to even crack a hundred passing yards on the day. He will try to do better against the 49ers next time out. But even that matchup is on the difficult side.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Atlanta Falcons D/ST overrun in loss to Panthers
items.desc: The Atlanta Falcons D/ST managed two sacks but not much else in their 34-3 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
items.impact: The Falcons' defense was completely outclassed by the Panthers' offense and was largely powerless to stop them. They're a tough unit to stream moving forward.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Nick Folk hits one field goal attempt in loss
items.desc: Nick Folk hit one of two field goal attempts in the Falcons' 34-3 loss to the Panthers.
items.impact: Folk had a chance to have a little better day, but failed to capitalize and missed the field goal. It's going to be tough to trust him moving forward after he's missed three of six total field goal attempts to start the year.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jack Strand struggles in relief action on Sunday
items.desc: Jack Strand completed 8 of 15 passes for 59 yards with a pick-six and a fumble in the Falcons' 34-3 loss to the Panthers on Sunday. He also ran twice for 16 yards.
items.impact: Strand got off to a rocky start with a pick-six three plays after he came in relief duty for the benched Cooper Rush. It will be tough to trust Strand or Rush at any point moving forward if the offense needs to rely on them.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Brian Robinson Jr. sees 11 carries in blowout loss
items.desc: Brian Robinson Jr. ran 11 times for 51 yards and caught both of his targets for 16 yards in the Falcons' 34-3 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
items.impact: Robinson likely saw an uptick in work in this one because of the blowout, otherwise Bijan would have seen more work. Brian will be a good handcuff with potential flex upside if the game script is right, but for now should mostly stay out of lineups.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Kyle Pitts Sr. snags one pass in win
items.desc: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught one of three targets for 15 yards in the Falcons' 34-3 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
items.impact: With the Falcons' QB play being so abysmal, it's hard to take anything away from the last two weeks. Hopefully we will see Michael Penix on Thursday to help bring some clarity and stability to the passing game.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Drake London quiet in loss to Panthers
items.desc: Drake London caught four of five targets for 51 yards in the Falcons' 34-3 loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
items.impact: London had a better game than last week, but it still is nowhere near what you drafted him to do. The Falcons' quarterback play has been abysmal so far, which is the primary contributor to his struggles. But hopefully Michael Penix can fix things if he can return on Thursday.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Cooper Rush abysmal in loss to Panthers
items.desc: Cooper Rush completed 10 of 17 passes for 86 yards with two picks in the Falcons' 34-3 loss to the Panthers on Sunday. He also ran twice for 20 yards and lost a fumble.
items.impact: It was an abysmal showing for Rush, who was benched halfway through for Jack Strand, who wasn't much, if any, better. Michael Penix is rumored to return to the lineup for Thursday's game, but if he doesn't, it's not worth starting any Falcon aside from Bijan Robinson.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Bijan Robinson held in check in Week 2 loss
items.desc: Bijan Robinson ran 16 times for 72 yards and caught three of four targets for nine yards in the Falcons' 34-3 blowout loss to the Panthers on Sunday.
items.impact: Robinson was fine on the ground, 4.5 yards per carry, but still largely held in check. The Panthers didn't allow the Falcons to move the ball, mostly thanks to Atlanta's lack of competent QB play. If Michael Penix returns on Thursday, that will hopefully be a huge boost to Bijan's value. If not, it's looking like another long night for Bijan managers.
